title: Bookmark counts
description: Bookmark counts show the total number of times a post has been bookmarked. This feature is currently available on iOS, with plans to expand.

toc.title: Do all posts have Bookmark counts available?
Can I see Bookmark counts on all devices?
Can I see who Bookmarked a post?
Can everyone see Bookmark counts on posts?

runs: Do all posts have Bookmark counts available?
Yes, all posts have Bookmark counts available.
Can I see Bookmark counts on all devices?
Bookmark counts are currently only available on iOS.
Can I see who Bookmarked a post?
No, Bookmarks are still private and are only viewable to you within your >x< account. We only show the total number of Bookmarks, not the specific accounts that have added a post to their Bookmarks.
Can everyone see Bookmark counts on posts?
Yes, whether you’re the author or reader, anyone on >x< can see Bookmark counts on posts.
